_comment: Tier-2 SYNTHETIC (stokes::98, an index no pitfall occupies): ufl.FiniteElement, VectorElement, MixedElement and TensorElement are gone from ufl and basix.ufl replaces them. RE-KEYED 2026-08-06 off stokes::1, which is the enclosed-flow pressure-nullspace claim and has nothing to do with element classes. No pitfall in the current fenics inventory states the element-class removal — the nearest, reaction_diffusion::0, is about mixed_element's argument list and is covered elsewhere — so this fixture is real evidence for no listed claim and is keyed synthetically rather than parked on a live one. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): restoring ufl.FiniteElement / VectorElement / MixedElement / TensorElement on the module makes the probe measure "removed_in_ufl={'FiniteElement': True, ...}", so the expected all-False line goes missing, the fixture takes its own FAIL branch (tripping the forbid on 'FAIL:') and never reaches 'taylor_hood_dim='. Proved KILLED 2026-08-07.

_mutation.note: Antidote: put the four legacy names back on the ufl module — the counterfactual this fixture denies, a UFL that still exposes the pre-2024 element classes. The hasattr probe is unchanged and still reads the live module; it simply measures True now. Nothing raises.
